tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search for real estate properties by ZIP code, city, state, status, property type, price range, bedrooms, bathrooms, and more. Returns up to 25 properties per call with address, price, beds, baths, square footage, year built, listing status, and price history.

tools.description: Get a single property by its Straply ID (an opaque string like 'stp_x7Kd9Qm2Rb', as returned by search_properties).
